1.source: LSJ s.v. ὑπέρμαχος (champion, vehement defender, subst. + gen. of the cause)

1.item: σπένδειν τοῖς ματαίοις εἰδώλοις (dat. of recipient)
1.source: Standard grammar, dative of the recipient of libation; LSJ σπένδω
1.sense_relied_on: pour drink-offerings to the idols, with ματαίοις = empty/vain

1.item: κατὰ πόλιν καὶ χώραν (distributive κατά + acc.)
1.sense_relied_on: city by city and countryside by countryside
